receipt.scope: Exact quadratic family and original zero-initial-value parameter theorem; arbitrary-point variant separately labelled derived consumer, no derivative interface claim.

cases.source:
have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
thm quadratic_initial_value_selects_parameter:
    ? forall c, y0 R:
        quadratic_solution(c, 0) = y0
        =>:
            c = y0
    quadratic_solution(c, 0) = 0^2 + c = c

have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
thm quadratic_initial_value_selects_parameter:
    ? forall c, y0 R:
        quadratic_solution(c, 0) = y0
        =>:
            c = y0
    quadratic_solution(c,0)=c

have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
thm quadratic_initial_value_selects_parameter:
    ? forall c, y0 R:
        quadratic_solution(c, 0) = y0
        =>:
            c = y0

have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
forall c,y0 R:
    quadratic_solution(c,0)=y0
    =>:
        c=y0

have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
thm quadratic_initial_value_selects_parameter:
    ? forall c, y0 R:
        quadratic_solution(c, 0) = y0
        =>:
            c = y0+1
    quadratic_solution(c,0)=c

have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
thm quadratic_initial_value_selects_parameter:
    ? forall c, y0 R:
        =>:
            c = y0
    quadratic_solution(c, 0) = 0^2 + c = c

have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
quadratic_solution(3,0)=3
quadratic_solution(-2,0)=-2

have fn quadratic_solution(c, x R) R = x^2 + c
thm arbitrary_initial_parameter:
    ? forall c,x0,y0 R:
        quadratic_solution(c,x0)=y0
        =>:
            c=y0-x0^2
    quadratic_solution(c,x0)=x0^2+c
